open_points.subject: serve_kernel
open_points.text: The mark is one object that serve_kernel creates before serving and that the handler sets and the loop reads — a variable of serve_kernel's closure or an attribute of the server instance — never an attribute of the handler instance, because HTTPServer builds a new handler for every request and a mark set on it is lost when the request ends.
open_points.rule: Реализацию: не пиши алгоритм построчно, пиши требования к поведению
open_points.question: Replace the implementation choices and HTTPServer-handler explanation with a behavioral requirement that the stop mark MUST be shared between the request handler and outer serving loop and MUST persist after the request handler returns.
